gaps: P0: only manuscripts and documents. P5, P6: no candidates.
notes: #11 date: Rijksmuseum gives only ‘after 1711’ (published by Johann Peter Wolff’s heirs, Nuremberg); ‘about 1720’ is an estimate for that firm’s city-view series — drop it if a firmer date is required. The view itself likely copies Merian’s 1654 plate. P3 alternative: #17 (about 1840) is a true general view from the southwest but small (1125 px) and gray; the color Poppel engraving was preferred. Many candidates are tagged ‘Braun & Hogenberg’ by mistake (documents, photochroms).
